exposure: Routine gastric residual aspiration before each feeding
Avoidance of routine gastric residual aspiration
outcome: Duration of invasive mechanical ventilator support
cohort: The study included 291 preterm infants with a gestational week ≤33, divided into a group with gastric residual control (169 infants) and a group without routine gastric residual aspiration (122 infants).
finding: Avoidance of routine gastric residual aspiration in preterm infants shortens the time to full enteral intake and the duration of invasive mechanical ventilator support without increasing the incidence of NEC.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was similar between the groups, but no specific finding related to mode of birth was reported.
birth_weight: Birth weight was similar between both groups, but specific values were not provided.
gest_age: Preterm infants with a gestational week ≤33; mean gestational week was 30.37±2.58 and 29.31±3.37 in the respective groups.
